Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the surname of the equine veterinarian was "Louviers" based on a search result snippet that described a historical figure from 1876 ("Around 1876, a horse doctor... named Louvrier"). The agent failed to verify if this specific reference existed in the target document (1.E Exercises by Marisa Alviar-Agnew & Henry Agnew, compiled 08/21/2023) or if the snippet was accurate. Furthermore, the name in the text is "Louvrier" (singular), and the agent erroneously pluralized it to "Louviers" without checking the source text. The Planner should have instructed the WebSurfer to open the specific result and read the full context to confirm the name and verify the source match before declaring the task complete.
